text: 中国1至10月社会融资规模增量 286100亿人民币，前值 274600亿人民币。 中国1至10月新增人民币贷款 114200亿人民币，前值 115200亿人民币。 中国10月M2货币供应同比 7.1%，前值 7.2%。 中国10月M1货币供应同比 4.4%，前值 3.2%。 中国10月M0货币供应同比 10.7%，前值 10.6%。
text_en: China's total social financing increment from January to October was RMB 28.61 trillion, previous value RMB 27.46 trillion. China's new RMB loans from January to October were RMB 11.42 trillion, previous value RMB 11.52 trillion. China's October M2 money supply rose 7.1% year-on-year, previous value 7.2%. China's October M1 money supply rose 4.4% year-on-year, previous value 3.2%. China's October M0 money supply rose 10.7% year-on-year, previous value 10.6%.
